content.text: Call the ask tool exactly once, before anything else, with exactly these two questions. Question 1: id "colour", header "Colour", question "Which colour do you prefer?", single choice, options Red (description "Warm"), Blue (description "Cool", preview "#0000ff"), recommended 1. Question 2: id "features", header "Features", question "Which features do you want?", multi true, options "Dark theme" (description "Dark colours"), "Mobile layout" (description "Small screens"), "Offline mode" (description "No network"). After I answer, reply with exactly: ANSWER=<colour>|<features>. Do not use any other tool.
